scanNote:
PHOTO FILE - UNIT 15 (raqamsiz bet, pdf 158, kitobning OXIRGI beti). Qirqib olinadigan karta. Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 15'.

E-MAIL OYNASI (eski Outlook uslubi, 'Message - Western Alphabet'): To: Kim@notor.co.uk; Cc: (bo'sh); Bcc: (bo'sh); Subject: Robson case.
Matn: 'Dear Kim, Just a quick note to check that I gave Janet Black the correct instructions concerning the Robson case.' Keyin katta BO'SH JOY (o'quvchi yozadi). Pastda: 'Hope I didn't forget anything. Phil Crawley'.

⚠ Bu 106-betdagi Writing (Project) uchun shablon: Phil Crawleyning Janet Blackka bergan 3 ko'rsatmasini (hujjatlarni yig'ish, chekni yubormaslik, janob Robsonga qo'ng'iroq qilish) ko'chirma buyruq shaklida yozish.

sections.title: Photo File - Unit 15: E-mail to Kim (Robson case)

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the e-mail template. Who is it to, who is it from and what is it about?
exercises.instructionUz: E-mail shabloniga qarang. Kimga, kimdan va nima haqida?
exercises.explanationUz:
E-MAIL QISMLARI:
  To: - kimga (Kim@notor.co.uk)
  Cc: - nusxa (bo'sh)
  Bcc: - yashirin nusxa (bo'sh)
  Subject: - mavzu (Robson case)


⚠ 'A CASE':

  = ish (yuridik/biznes ish).
  ⚠ 'the Robson case' = Robson
  ishi.


⚠ 'CONCERNING':

  = ...ga oid, ... haqida
  (rasmiy). = 'about'.


⚠ 'JUST A QUICK NOTE TO ...':

  = ... uchun qisqa xat
  (e-mail boshlanishi).

items.answerEn: To check that he gave Janet Black the correct instructions concerning the Robson case.
items.answerUz: Robson ishiga oid Janet Blackka to'g'ri ko'rsatmalar berganini tekshirish uchun.

exercises.instructionEn: Put Phil's instructions to Janet into reported speech.
exercises.instructionUz: Philning Janetga bergan ko'rsatmalarini ko'chirma gapga aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA BUYRUQ (106-bet, 7-mashq):
  tell/ask + kishi + TO + fe'l
  tell/ask + kishi + NOT TO + fe'l

  'Collect ...' → told her TO collect
  'Don't send ...' → told her NOT
    TO send
  'Call ...' → asked her TO call

items.textEn: "Collect all the documents and leave them with the receptionist." → I told her ___ all the documents and leave them with the receptionist.
"Don't send the cheque to the Crown Street Office yet." → I told her ___ the cheque to the Crown Street Office yet.
"Call Mr Robson to arrange a meeting for next Friday." → I asked her ___ Mr Robson to arrange a meeting for next Friday.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete Phil's e-mail to Kim (Unit 15, Writing Project, p. 106). Phil gave Janet Black these instructions: "Collect all the documents and leave them with the receptionist." "Don't send the cheque to the Crown Street Office yet." "Call Mr Robson to arrange a meeting for next Friday."
exercises.instructionUz: Philning Kimga e-mailini to'ldiring (15-unit, Yozuv loyihasi, 106-bet). Phil Janet Blackka bu ko'rsatmalarni berdi: "Barcha hujjatlarni yig'ing va qabulxona xodimiga qoldiring." "Chekni hali Crown Street ofisiga yubormang." "Kelasi juma uchrashuv belgilash uchun janob Robsonga qo'ng'iroq qiling."
exercises.explanationUz:
E-MAIL QOLIPI (106-bet, 10-mashq):
  Dear ...,
  Just a quick note to check that
  I gave ... the correct
  instructions concerning ...
  I told him/her to ...
  I told him/her not to ...
  I also asked him/her to ...
  Hope I didn't forget anything.
  + ism

  ⚠ Shablonda BOSHI va OXIRI
  tayyor - faqat o'rtasini
  (3 ko'chirma buyruq) yozasiz.

modelAnswers:
To: Kim@notor.co.uk
Subject: Robson case

Dear Kim,

Just a quick note to check that I gave Janet Black the correct instructions concerning the Robson case. I told her to collect all the documents and leave them with the receptionist. I told her not to send the cheque to the Crown Street Office yet. I also asked her to call Mr Robson to arrange a meeting for next Friday.

Hope I didn't forget anything.
Phil Crawley
modelAnswersUz:
Kimga: Kim@notor.co.uk
Mavzu: Robson ishi

Aziz Kim,

Robson ishiga oid Janet Blackka to'g'ri ko'rsatmalar berganimni tekshirish uchun qisqa xat. Men unga barcha hujjatlarni yig'ib, qabulxona xodimiga qoldirishni aytdim. Unga chekni hali Crown Street ofisiga yubormaslikni aytdim. Undan kelasi juma uchrashuv belgilash uchun janob Robsonga qo'ng'iroq qilishni ham so'radim.

Hech narsani unutmagan bo'lsam kerak.
Phil Crawley
